content.short: Space themed Cardano metaverse and gamification ecosystem.
content.description:
Cardanauts is a collaboration project between Cardanaut Joe (JvP) and TurboEgon (creator of Stellarhood) that brings space exploration, resource gathering, logistics, base management, NFT trading and game progression mechanics to the Cardano blockchain, while exploring the innovative frontiers of the Cardano NFT ecosystems.

Join us on this journey of discovery, exploration and gain your Cardanaut wings!
